basics.name: Jiayi Guo
basics.label: Incoming M.S. Student in Computer Science
basics.summary: Incoming M.S. student in Computer Science at UC San Diego working on LLM evaluation, RAG, multimodal AutoML, diffusion models, and trustworthy AI systems.

work.position: Large Language Models for Automated Machine Learning
work.summary: Independent research project on LLM-driven automation of discriminative and generative machine-learning workflows.
highlights: Led experiments across multiple datasets and task settings.
Evaluated framework performance and conducted a 25-participant user study.
Wrote the paper accepted by IEEE BIBM 2025.

work.position: Diffusion Models for Virtual Try-On Systems
work.summary: Research on single-image garment replacement using diffusion models.
highlights: Developed staged and partial replacement methods for sleeve changes.
Improved visual realism and garment-fitting quality through model and pipeline adjustments.

work.company: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China
work.position: Generative AI in Semantic Communication Systems
work.summary: Research on generative AI for latent-space compression and reconstruction in communication systems.
highlights: Adapted AI models to complex-valued communication scenarios.

education.institution: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China & University of Glasgow

publications.name: A Human-Centered Multimodal AutoML Framework for Discriminative and Generative Tasks with Large Language Models
publications.summary: J. Guo, L. Zhang, and Y. Shen.

publications.name: When Do LLM Agents Treat Surface Noise Differently from Semantic Noise? A 68-Cell Measurement Study with a Held-Out Trace-Level Validation

portfolio.name: Resource-Aware LLM/RAG Evaluation Service
portfolio.description: Built a local-first FastAPI evaluation service with document retrieval, a JSON benchmark schema, answer-quality and reliability metrics, optional DeepSeek judging, and Markdown/HTML reports.

portfolio.name: Kaggle Playground Series: Predicting Irrigation Need
portfolio.description: Built a tabular ML pipeline and ranked 16th out of 4,315 participants, placing in the top 3%.

portfolio.name: Advertiser Growth CRM Backend Extension
portfolio.description: Extended Spring PetClinic REST with advertiser workflows, RBAC, optimistic locking, transactional outbox events, Kafka retry handling, Redis caching, and observability.

portfolio.name: Trustworthy Code-Change Review Agent with Evaluation and Observability
portfolio.description: Built a typed multi-agent code-review service with FastAPI and CLI interfaces, evaluation and observability, prompt-injection defenses, PII and credential redaction, and 27 unit/integration tests.
